settings.headline: A public library since 1911, with five branches and a bus
settings.subtitle: Ossingford Public Library (fictional) serves about 118,000 people in Ossingford County from four buildings and a Bookmobile. The library, its people, places and figures are fictional; this is a Raytha example site.

settings.headline: What the library is for
settings.body:
Free to use, for everyone in the county: books and films, a quiet place to work, the internet, help with a form, a room for a club, the town's own history, and storytime on a Monday morning.

The library is governed by a seven-member board appointed by the county (story) and is funded by the county levy, with help from the Friends of the Library.

— Celia Marrow, library director (fictional)
settings.card: Meets the third Thursday of each month at 6 pm in the Kettle Room, Central Library. Agendas are posted on the news page a week before.
